name: St Patrick's White Chocolate Bark with Pistachios & Rainbow Sprinkles

instructions.primary_message: Line the bottom of a small baking dish with parchment paper and set aside.
Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a simmer over medium-high heat.

Uncover the pan and place a medium, heat-proof, bowl over the simmering water, allowing it to sit on the rim. Add chocolate and oil to the bowl; using a silicone spatula, stir continuously, until melted.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup white chocolate chips
1 tsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.primary_message: Remove bowl from the heat. Add salt and food coloring, then stir until chocolate is smooth and bright green in color.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅛ tsp salt
8 drop green food coloring

instructions.primary_message: Pour chocolate mixture into the baking dish. Using the silicone spatula, spread out to a thickness of ¼-inch.
Scatter pistachios and sprinkles over the chocolate. Place baking dish in the refrigerator and chill until bark is firm, 10-15 minutes.
Remove bark from the refrigerator, transfer to a cutting board, and chop into large pieces. Store in the refrigerator until ready to serve.
To serve, arrange chocolate bark on a platter. Enjoy!
